people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, and he, and her house, ate many days.
translations.bsb: So she went and did according to the word of Elijah, and there was food every day for Elijah and the woman and her household.
translations.kjv: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
translations.asv: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
